title: Clickety-Clack Cuttlefish
statement: Beneath a canopy of swaying silver kelp, this pint-sized cephalopod spends its days tapping pieces of frosted sea glass together just to hear them chime, meticulously sorting its favorites into neat geometric spirals on the dark sand. Whenever a particularly pleasing pattern clicks into place, ripples of warm amber and violet luminescence dance across its skin.
